page.overview:
Who is Skeleton?

Bedrock Edition: depending on proximity Easy and Normal: - , Hard: - , Java Edition: depending on proximity Easy: - Normal: - Hard: - Melee Easy and Normal: Hard:

In the Nether: at a light level of seven or less and inside a Nether Fortress or the biomeTrial Chambers.

Skeletons are undead common hostile mobs that perform ranged attacks with a bow by shooting arrows.

A skeleton may spawn above a solid block at a light level of zero in the Overworld except in mushroom fields and deep dark biomes, usually in small groups of up to four skeletons in Java Edition or two skeletons in Bedrock Edition. 80% of skeletons spawned directly under the sky in snowy plains, ice spikes, frozen oceans, deep frozen oceans and legacy frozen oceans biomes spawn as stray mobs.
